title: Enough for Today
subtitle: A reflection on Matthew 6:25–34

beats.label: Begin
beats.narration: Welcome to Daily Breath. Take a slow breath. Let your shoulders soften. For these few minutes, you don’t have to solve everything at once.
beats.visualPrompt: Quiet morning light across a simple room; soft greens and warm cream; slow camera drift.

beats.label: Today’s passage
beats.narration: Today’s reading is Matthew 6:25–34. Jesus teaches his listeners not to be consumed by worry about food, clothing, or tomorrow. He points to the birds and the flowers as reminders of God’s care. Then he gives this instruction: “Therefore don’t be anxious for tomorrow, for tomorrow will be anxious for itself. Each day’s own evil is sufficient.”
beats.visualPrompt: Birds moving through a sunlit garden; lilies and wildflowers in a breeze; scripture reference appears quietly.

beats.label: Reflect
beats.narration: Jesus isn’t saying that life has no real needs, or that planning is wrong. He is turning our attention toward the day in front of us. Worry pulls us into a future we can’t control. This passage invites us to meet today with trust, and to seek God’s kingdom and righteousness first.
beats.visualPrompt: A winding path through a green landscape, with one clear step illuminated ahead and the distant horizon soft.

beats.label: Consider
beats.narration: What is one thing you’re carrying from tomorrow into today? You don’t have to pretend it doesn’t matter. Name it honestly. Then ask: what is the next faithful step I can take today?
beats.onScreenText: What is your next faithful step?
beats.visualPrompt: A journal beside a window; a hand writes one small next step in morning light.

beats.label: Practice
beats.narration: Maybe it’s making a call, asking for help, finishing one small task, or resting when you need rest. The passage doesn’t promise that every difficulty disappears. It offers a way to face this day without letting tomorrow take all of today’s breath.
beats.onScreenText: One step. One day at a time.
beats.visualPrompt: A few ordinary acts of care: a phone placed beside a note, a task completed, a quiet cup of tea.

beats.label: Pause
beats.narration: For now, return to this moment. Breathe in. Breathe out. Take the next step you can take, and leave the rest with God.
beats.visualPrompt: Still leaves moving gently in a light breeze; hold a spacious, quiet frame.

beats.label: Prayer
beats.narration: God, thank you for meeting us in this day. Help us release the worries we cannot resolve right now. Give us wisdom for the next step, courage to ask for help, and trust in your care. Teach us to seek what is good and faithful today. Amen.
beats.visualPrompt: Warm light across an open Bible on a table; gentle stillness without depicting a specific religious figure.

beats.label: Carry this with you
beats.narration: May you carry one day at a time. This has been Daily Breath.
beats.onScreenText: May you carry one day at a time.
beats.visualPrompt: A calm sunrise over a simple horizon; fade slowly to the Daily Breath mark.

sources.notes: Scripture text and passage summary are taken from the public-domain WEB; devotional reflection and prayer are original.

outroText: Take today one step at a time.
